summary: Daily Super Grok switch. supergrok_daily_guard.py (cron every 5 min) is the single switch owner. It reads daily_budget from the aisystem app (new GET /ai/usage_pacing_json): budget = (week_off_at 90 - used% at PT midnight) / days left. Today: (90-53.0)/6.44 = 5.7%/day; 1.0% used so far; live 54.0% matches the 54% reading. When today's use reaches the budget, Hermes default + code/coder -> openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash and the grok-build fallback is dropped. It restores grok-4.7 + grok-build fallback on the first run after midnight PT. The overrun guard restore now respects the daily lock.

metrics.openrouter_glm: z-ai/glm-5.3-flash $0.15/M in, $0.50/M out, 1M ctx (Relace in provider list but ignored by provider_routing)

proposals.title: Super Grok daily budget in pacing + /ai/usage_pacing_json + banner
proposals.rationale: daily_budget() is pure. It uses (week_off_at - used at PT midnight) / fractional days left. The day-start value is normalized to readings: when there is a reading on each side of midnight, the meter delta is split by weighted tokens (1.3x for prompts over 200K). Overrides live in data/supergrok_pacing.json under "daily": week_off_at, extra_today_pct + extra_today_date, allow_overrun_date. allow_overrun releases the daily lock only; the week cutoff still applies. The card shows a 'Daily budget' row and a red banner when the budget is used: open sessions keep their model, so run /model glm. GET /ai/usage_pacing_json (same access as usage_live) returns just this block for the guard.

payload.undo: cd ~/.comserv/worktrees/aisystem/Comserv/Comserv && for f in SuperGrokPacing.pm:lib/Comserv/Util/AI UsageMonitor.pm:lib/Comserv/Model/AI2 Usage.pm:lib/Comserv/Controller/AI usage_pacing_card.tt:root/ai ai_supergrok_pacing.t:t; do cp ~/.comserv/backups/aisystem-20261009/${f%%:*}.pre-r6 ${f#*:}/${f%%:*}; done

proposals.title: supergrok_daily_guard.py: daily switch to openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash from app numbers; midnight restore to grok-4.7
proposals.rationale: The guard is the single owner of the switch. It uses supergrok_pacing.daily_budget instead of the add-on meter (stale: Build 1/40%) and the flat 0.05%/call estimate. The old 'yesterday over cap' rule is retired; yesterday's overspend is already in the smaller budget. When the budget is used, the lock is sticky for the PT day. The switch sets provider/default/base_url/api_mode, sets code/coder to openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, and removes the xai grok-build fallback, leaving north-mini/nemotron :free and then Ollama. It never writes v4-pro. On a new PT day, or an override for today, it restores grok-4.7, the code/coder aliases and the grok-build fallback. If the app is down it keeps an existing lock and takes no new one. Each switch sends notify-send telling Shanta to run /model glm (or /model code on restore) in open sessions, writes ~/.hermes/supergrok_notice.txt, adds an inbox line in data/ai_eval_inbox/<date>-supergrok-daily-switch.json, and writes a ledger row. 24 python tests pass (4 stale tests updated).

payload.undo: cp ~/.hermes/scripts/supergrok_daily_guard.py.bak-20261009-0814 ~/.hermes/scripts/supergrok_daily_guard.py && cp ~/.hermes/scripts/test_supergrok_daily_guard.py.bak-20261009-0814 ~/.hermes/scripts/test_supergrok_daily_guard.py (if a switch happened: cp ~/.hermes/config.yaml.bak-20261009-0814 ~/.hermes/config.yaml)

proposals.title: Overrun guard restore respects the daily Super Grok lock
proposals.rationale: If the overrun guard trips while on grok-4.7 and the daily lock is taken during the trip, restore now writes the daily guard's cheap model (from supergrok_guard_state.json switch_*), sets code/coder to the same model, and drops Super Grok from the fallback (already done via supergrok_available). This happens only while lock_date is today PT; on the next day it restores grok-4.7 as before. 191 tests pass.

proposals.title: Seed Super Grok reading 54% at Fri Oct 9 08:12 PT
proposals.rationale: Shanta via the AI usage monitor. Before seeding, the estimate's last anchor was 41% at 19:04. Interpolating by tokens puts 53.0% at midnight, so 1.0% used today.

proposals.title: Autostart the :4006 aisystem server after reboot (the daily switch depends on it)
proposals.target: crontab @reboot or a systemd user unit
proposals.rationale: The workstation rebooted at 06:31 PT; :4006 was down until 08:15, so the burn alerts (599 errors) and the new daily switch were blind. I started it with nohup (same command as shell history). It will not survive the next reboot. Not applied.

payload.apply: @reboot sleep 60 && cd /home/shanta/.comserv/worktrees/aisystem/Comserv/Comserv && PATH=/home/shanta/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.0/bin:$PATH PERL5LIB=/home/shanta/perl5/lib/perl5 CATALYST_DEBUG=1 COMSERV_NO_HEALTH_LOG=1 perl script/comserv_server.pl -p 4006 -r >> /home/shanta/.comserv/logs/aisystem-4006.log 2>&1
